subject: dsa
title: Sliding Window Maximum
summary: Keep a deque of indices whose values decrease front-to-back, so the front is always the window's max. As the window slides, drop indices that fell out of range and pop smaller values off the back before pushing the new one.
problem: Given an array and a window size k, report the maximum of every contiguous window of size k.

steps.caption: Report the max of every size-3 window of nums. A deque keeps useful indices in decreasing value, so its front is always the current max.
First window [1, 3, -1] covers indices 0 to 2. The deque front points at 3, so the window max is 3.
Slide right to [3, -1, -3], indices 1 to 3. The 1 at index 0 left the window, but 3 still leads, so the max is still 3.
Slide to [-1, -3, 5], indices 2 to 4. 5 is bigger than every earlier candidate, so they pop off the back and 5 becomes the new max.
Each index is pushed and popped at most once, so the whole sweep is O(n). The window maxima are [3, 3, 5].
